How to Save Products

1

1-Click Toolbar Icon

Click the VaultXMedia icon in your Chrome toolbar on any product page. It instantly extracts and saves the product directly into your Vault without any popup or modal.

2

In-Page Floating Button

When browsing Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Meesho, or Nykaa, a discreet floating button appears at the bottom-right corner. Click it to save with an instant confirmation toast.

3

Right-Click Context Menu

Right-click any link or product image across the web and select "Save to VaultXMedia Wishlist".
